label: D2 after choosing a2 following a reward that broke a non-rewarded streak (episode trials 10-49)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost only when this trial chose a2 (99.4% of mass) and the previous trial was rewarded (99.9% of mass). Within that, it fires mostly on the first such trial after a non-rewarded trial: when the trial two back was unrewarded (or is outside the window) it fires, and on later trials in a run of rewarded a2 choices it decays to small or no activation. It is also strongly gated by time in the episode: almost all activity falls in episode trials 10-49 and there is essentially none after trial 55, so this is probably a slowly drifting hidden-state component that the threshold cuts, not a clean input detector. Activations are larger when the hidden good state is S2 and the policy strongly favours a2. The largest activations (rare) come from a1 choices right after a rewarded a2 streak. It never fires at D1/GO, after unrewarded trials, or on a1 trials in general. Every variable used is observed at D2. Dev: P 0.35, R 0.76, mass recall 0.90; the stricter prev-prev-unrewarded version has F1 0.51 but mass recall 0.69. Without the episode-time gate, precision drops to about 0.2.
